required_columns.raw_p_value: float_or_empty; present only when H selects a candidate
required_columns.holm_adjusted_p_value: float_or_empty; present only when H selects a candidate

refusal_reason_rule: The refusal label is a deterministic summary of the registered decision and never adds a decision gate. diagnostic_failure_subtype is computed only after certified=false and cannot change certified. no_candidate_certified covers both absence of a risk-passing candidate and nonpositive coverage among risk-passing candidates.
model_failure_rule: A frozen-training NaN or divergence writes all three H/S/B primary rows with certified=false, selected_candidate=-1, coverage_lcb=0, ECA=0, refusal_reason=model_failure, and explicitly empty unavailable hashes. The seed is never replaced.

proposal_family_file.name: PROPOSAL_FAMILY_MANIFEST.csv.gz
proposal_family_file.failure_placeholder_rule: A terminal model failure retains 12 ordered placeholder rows with proposal_feasible=false and empty score-derived quantities.

count_file.name: PRIMARY_COUNTS.csv.gz
count_file.ordering_constraint: Every model retains 48 candidate-client rows. For model-evaluable rows, 0 <= K <= A <= n and n=128. For terminal model failure, n/A/K are explicitly empty and status=model_failure.

primary_candidate_decision_file.name: PRIMARY_CANDIDATE_DECISIONS.csv.gz

required_columns.raw_max_client_p: float_or_empty; populated for H model-evaluable candidates
required_columns.holm_rank: integer[1,12]_or_empty; populated for H model-evaluable candidates
required_columns.holm_critical_value: float_or_empty; populated for H model-evaluable candidates
required_columns.holm_adjusted_p: float_or_empty; populated for H model-evaluable candidates
required_columns.risk_ucb: float_or_empty; populated for S and B model-evaluable candidates

primary_candidate_decision_file.failure_placeholder_rule: A terminal model failure retains 36 ordered placeholder rows, candidate_certified=false, selected=false, and empty inferential quantities.
primary_candidate_decision_file.mandatory_candidate_reporting: All 12 H raw and Holm-adjusted p-values, all 12 S and B risk UCBs, and all procedure-specific coverage LCBs are retained regardless of selection.

secondary_procedure_file.name: SECONDARY_AUDIT_REPLICATES.csv.gz
secondary_procedure_file.registered_grid: budget_total in {256,512,1024}, replicate_id in {0,...,99}, excluding the primary pair (512,0)
secondary_procedure_file.rule: Secondary rows cannot alter primary outputs or verdict.

secondary_count_file.name: SECONDARY_COUNTS.csv.gz
secondary_count_file.ordering_constraint: 30 models x 299 secondary audit configurations x 12 candidates x 4 clients; terminal model failures retain explicit placeholder rows.

secondary_candidate_decision_file.name: SECONDARY_CANDIDATE_DECISIONS.csv.gz
secondary_candidate_decision_file.ordering_constraint: 30 models x 299 secondary audit configurations x 12 candidates x 3 procedures; terminal model failures retain explicit placeholder rows.

conditional_certified_coverage_rule: When the certified denominator is zero, CondCertCov is NA and its denominator is reported as zero; it is never encoded as numeric zero.

candidate_level: candidate_certified implies proposal_feasible and risk_pass and coverage_positive
cell_level: at most one selected candidate per model and procedure
selected_count equals one iff at least one candidate is certified, otherwise zero
ECA equals certified multiplied by coverage_lcb
H, S, and B share the same count_tensor_sha256 for each model, budget, and replicate
the selected candidate is exactly the certified candidate maximizing the frozen tie-break tuple
the candidate table aggregates exactly to the 90-row primary summary
